artifacts.proves: a surface ran at a time, and whether it passed
artifacts.does_not_prove: anything about a surface with no heartbeat, which must be shown as absent

artifacts.proves: the edge was traversed by a real run
artifacts.does_not_prove: that data was processed on it

artifacts.proves: how much of the declared graph the run could speak for
artifacts.does_not_prove: that an unexercised edge is broken

consumer_notes: read this index first; absence is a value here, not a failed file read
the observations are host-local and git-ignored, so a fresh checkout has none and that is not an error
each artifact states what it proves and what it does not; a display must not upgrade the weaker claim
freshness is the consumer's judgement: compare produced_at against whatever window it declares
